question: Can a persistent sparse structural-energy learner discover causal factor supports unknown to it from randomized interventions, learn one newly introduced mechanism without catastrophically forgetting older causal relations, and transfer to a third untrained nuisance distribution better than strong fully trained conventional learners?
hypothesis: The single learner will recover at least 60% of the hidden causal motif supports, retain earlier effect prediction within 10% MSE of its prior checkpoint, and reduce cold-shift MSE by at least 10% relative to the best conventional trained baseline with no more than 2x OMP local training+inference cost.

inputs.name: Original source-free synthetic intervention-consequence hidden-factor generator
inputs.source: Reproducible SHA256-derived seed streams in frozen experiment.py; no external/protected dataset or model checkpoint

source_program.modeled_factor_grammar: Known grammar generated from intervention inputs: P1 (12), P2 (66), P3 (220), A2 (66): 364 candidate supports (728 including new-stage-gated copies). No ground-truth planted factor supports or weights supplied to any learner; however grammar itself is supplied to all structured models and not discovered.
source_program.per_world_sharing: 3 invariant causal factors plus 1 old-only factor and 1 new-only factor, independently signed weights magnitude .85-1.15; all selected from first 10 causal action bits, candidate does not know which bits are causal.
source_program.observations: Each label is the additive real-valued consequence of active signed parity/conjunction factors plus seeded Gaussian noise sigma=0.3. Inputs are randomized externally set do-interventions, not passively observed correlations; this is not an active action-selection test.
source_program.distribution_shifts: Old: cue10 approximately copies bit0, cue11 bit1; new: cue10 approximately reverses bit0, cue11 copies bit2; cold: cues10/11 independent random. Held old/new and new-mechanism cold groups use separately seeded action and noise streams.
source_program.conditioned_context: Old/new context stage label is known to all learners for new-stage-gated grammar. Cold test is new-context mechanism with cue distribution unseen in training.
source_program.evaluation_leakage: Generator truth, true latent supports and all held consequences used only in evaluator. No test labels during fitting or feature selection.

frozen_design.causal_factor_cap: 7 selected shared/new-gated supports for energy candidate, no-memory and OMP structural-memory; 4 stage-one supports, top3 old factors locked during new stage, 20 ridge anchor penalty; exhaustive OMP gets 7 nonzero supports. Ridge and ElasticNet dense coefficients and RandomForest larger capacity reported separately as stronger heterocapacity controls.
frozen_design.learner: Stage one residual-energy factor discovery via deterministic normalized correlation contrast over grammar, recursive least-squares with 0.02 ridge; stage two retains three stage-one factor structures, rehearses all old+new observed consequences, penalizes drift of stage-one coefficients with lambda20, and adds up to four new supports. This is explicit sparse regression over a known finite composition grammar, not arbitrary unknown operator discovery.
arms: energy_no_memory (no locked motifs or coefficient anchoring)
omp_structural_memory (4 OMP old factors, 3 locked, same discovered capacity and replay but no coefficient anchor)
omp_full (scikit-learn OMP n_nonzero_coefs=7 fit_intercept=True on cumulative labels)
forest_raw (60 trees, max_depth9,min_samples_leaf3 on raw action+context)
shuffled_energy (identical sparse source but SHA256-permuted 192 training consequences)
negative_controls: energy_no_memory same 192 observations with no retention lock
strong_controls: omp_structural_memory same factor grammar+support budget+old structural replay
frozen_design.seeds_and_order: SHA256 key E43:v1, independent source domains; seed=case_id=f'{world_id}:{family}'; frozen sequential order seed→world id→family→arm
frozen_design.time_definition: Single CPU local per-arm measured fit_s+pred_s; all arms charged the same shared old/new design construction; individual arm repeated cold/old/new design and predict captured, not whole host or CI/GitHub/wall provisioning cost.
frozen_design.runtime: Linux CPU, Python 3.13.5 NumPy 2.3.5 SciPy 1.17.0 scikit-learn 1.8.0, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1; no GPU/paid API.
frozen_design.budget: 36 primary worlds and one unchanged-source semantic replay plus independent refit audit; not more than 1 primary scoring run, no tuning on primary.

metrics: Mean held cold MSE on fresh cue distribution vs best conventional fully fitted model
Mean exact identified true factor supports from five world-generating motifs (exact-match support, ignores coefficient sign; gate key includes 'shared' but denominator is all five motifs)
Old held MSE immediately after stage one versus after stage two
Old held MSE against best fully trained non-sham conventional model
Cold held MSE against label-shuffled negative
Seed-wise strict cold MSE improvement against best conventional control
Local per-arm fit+eval CPU wall seconds versus OMP7

frozen_gates.cold_relative_gain_vs_strongest_10pct: Mean candidate cold MSE <= .90 * minimum mean cold MSE over omp_structural_memory,omp_full,ridge_full,elastic_net_full,forest_raw.
frozen_gates.shared_factor_recall_at_least_60pct: Mean recall of ALL FIVE hidden true factor supports across 36 worlds >=.60. Name is legacy; includes three shared plus two stage-specific supports, NOT only shared factors.
frozen_gates.old_retention_inflation_at_most_10pct: After-stage-two old MSE <=1.10 times candidate old MSE immediately after stage one.
frozen_gates.old_no_worse_than_best_control_5pct: Candidate old-after-stage-two MSE <=1.05 times minimum old MSE among the same five fully fitted controls.
frozen_gates.sham_negative_cold_relative_gain_20pct: Candidate cold MSE <=.80 times label-shuffled energy control cold MSE.
frozen_gates.seed_stability_two_of_three: Strict candidate mean cold MSE lower than strongest conventional baseline separately within >=2 of 3 primary seeds (three-seed smoke is not required; smoke seed excluded).
frozen_gates.fit_and_eval_cost_at_most_2x_omp: Total candidate measured fit_s+pred_s over all 36 worlds <=2.0 times full-grammar OMP7 fit_s+pred_s over same worlds.

decision_rules.development_go: All 7 frozen gates PASS AND independently authored full-source/world/model audit PASS; still not native scientific qualification.
decision_rules.development_no_go: Any one gate FAIL with protocol/independent audit intact. Preserve all measured results and stop tuning against evaluated primary seeds.
decision_rules.invalid: Source SHA mismatch, early primary outcome before prereg, source/held label leakage, identity drift, missing strong controls, broken independent source/model audit, unequal observed training labels, code path altered after freeze. Treat infrastructure separately.
decision_rules.mixed: Report all gates with point estimates and relevant per-seed/family breakdowns; no postscore gate or selection changes.

preprimary_smoke.interpretation: Only implementation validation; 6/7 smoke gates passed but stability gate defined on three primary seeds is not meaningful on one excluded smoke seed. Never classify smoke as development go.

prohibited_after_freeze: No additional primary evaluations beyond one exact-source unchanged replay
No native scientific first-use, Yggdrasil model changes, accepted ref mutation, controller/scheduler/runner changes, merge/promotion, deployment
preregistration_note: Exact frozen experiment and auditor are committed in source_commit_sha. Primary seeds 8617,8629,8651 have NOT been run at this preregistration boundary.
